key_insight: HealthAgentBench is a new 54-task benchmark that tests whether AI agents can complete realistic, multi-step healthcare workflows end to end.
clinical_relevance: It helps measure how close frontier AI agents are to being useful in real healthcare operations, not just in isolated text tasks.
method: Built 54 agentic healthcare tasks across 7 categories, each with its own environment.
Tasks span the patient journey and multiple modalities, requiring agents to explore raw data and execute multi-step actions.
Benchmarked frontier agents using a single final task success rate for overall performance.
evidence_signal: Across the benchmark, overall success stayed low; the strongest and most cost-effective agent, Codex GPT-5.5, reached only about 42% success.
watch_item: Results come from a benchmark environment, so performance may not fully translate to real clinical settings with different workflows, constraints, and safety requirements.
paper_title: HealthAgentBench: A Unified Benchmark Suite of Realistic Agentic Healthcare Environments for Challenging Frontier AI Agents
